periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, extending towards the posterosuperior cranial region.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan discoloration across the ventral abdominal fur and a darkened patch of fur in the lower pelvic region.
